newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end up after Sindh cabinet formed.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end up after Sindh cabinet formed.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed sharply up on Thursday on short-covering encouraged by the formation of the Sindh provincial cabinet, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-share index closed 32.11 points, or 2.08 percent, up at 1,575.29 amid 158 losers and 127 gainers in a turnover of 41 million, down from Wednesday's 51 million.

Dealer Asif Janmohammad attributed the rise to the swearing-in of a 16-member Sindh cabinet, ending political uncertainty in the province. Big investors, on the selling side for the past two sessions, covered their short positions.
Dealers said prices would open up on Friday.
